rating_legend.F: Future functionality on roadmap within 1-2 years
rating_legend.Y: Fully supported by the current release

requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate a governed citywide record model across at least two departments with retained provenance and access boundaries.
requirements.title: Unify records management citywide

requirements.acceptance: Show policy selection, retention calculation, hold handling, and disposition eligibility with an auditable decision trail.
requirements.title: Identify records and apply Washington retention schedules

requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate disposition approval and immutable destruction-log evidence without allowing silent deletion.
requirements.title: Controlled disposal after retention period

requirements.acceptance: Run a scripted request across representative repositories and produce a reproducible responsive-record set.
requirements.title: Identify records responsive to public disclosure requests

requirements.acceptance: Prove export-set integrity using immutable identifiers or checksums and an auditable chain of custody.
requirements.title: Preserve responsive-record immutability

requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate reversible review workflow, irreversible released-copy redaction, and retained redaction rationale.
requirements.title: Support exempt-information redaction

requirements.acceptance: Export a mixed-format responsive set in native formats with manifest metadata suitable for GovQA handoff.
requirements.title: Export responsive records in native format for GovQA

requirements.acceptance: Execute agreed findability scenarios across indexed repositories and record precision, recall, latency, and permission filtering.
requirements.title: Improve document and records search

requirements.acceptance: Create and query a controlled metadata/catalog model while preserving source provenance and lifecycle fields.
requirements.title: Organize and facilitate cataloging of records

requirements.acceptance: Provide architecture evidence covering deployment boundaries, identity flow, administrative roles, and data residency.
requirements.title: Document deployment, data-center security, and SSO posture

requirements.acceptance: Map current certifications and controls, RPO/RTO evidence, support commitments, and exceptions to source artifacts.
requirements.title: Document security compliance, disaster recovery, and SLA

requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate authenticated integration for a representative source and export target with retry and audit behavior.
requirements.title: Describe interface and integration tools

requirements.acceptance: Inventory AI-enabled functions, model/data boundaries, human review, logging, opt-out controls, and roadmap claims.
requirements.title: Describe AI strategy and available/future functionality

requirements.acceptance: Produce a phased plan with named roles, dependencies, migration gates, acceptance criteria, and schedule assumptions.
requirements.title: Provide implementation team, qualifications, methodology, timeframe, and phases

requirements.acceptance: Map support tiers and escalation paths to contractual response targets and test the escalation handoff.
requirements.title: Provide support hours, response times, resources, escalation, and post-go-live services

requirements.acceptance: Validate reference consent, comparable scope, implementation status, and contactability without fabricating credentials.
requirements.title: Provide similar-size/scope customer references

requirements.acceptance: Run a pre-submission manifest check for required files, original template formats, page limit, and nonblank Exhibit A responses.
requirements.title: Complete required proposal PDF plus Exhibits A/C Word and Exhibit B Excel
